subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat convert assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep the current markdown-capable behavior and narrow this issue to the typing-name bug?
rationale: Current source declares Google Chat markdown-capable and Google Chat supports a limited markdown dialect, but the issue asks to avoid raw assistant Markdown; automation should not choose the permanent channel rendering policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Convert supported markup
options.body: Implement a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported syntax, strips or degrades unsupported constructs, and also fixes the `identity.name` typing fallback.

options.title: Plain text only
options.body: Treat Google Chat as a plain-text channel, strip Markdown before delivery, and update metadata, docs, and tests to remove the current markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing fix only
options.body: Land only the `identity.name` typing fallback and document that Google Chat currently receives markdown-capable text without full dialect conversion.

recommendation.title: Convert supported markup
recommendation.body: Implement a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported syntax, strips or degrades unsupported constructs, and also fixes the `identity.name` typing fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from Google Chat commit history, reply-delivery refactors, and the prior product-direction review comment.
